none: PAS NCL-3D2907: NCL-3D2907: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A military lead sealing dating to the Roman period. The sealing is rectangular in shape and section. The obverse of the sealing is struck with letters LVI ( leg(io) VI ). The lower surface has a rectangular die and is struck with the legend [O]VA although this obscured by damage to the piercing.
